name: Youth Volunteers Program
what_you_do: Earn service hours at a free science museum. You help guests in the galleries and IMAX theater, greet visitors, or help in the gift store.
who_can_apply: High school juniors and seniors who are 16 or 17.
pay_detail: Unpaid. You earn community service hours.
duration: One 4-hour shift a week, usually on the weekend, for 14 weeks (50 or more hours)
deadline_text: Spring 2027 applications are open: the volunteer page now links the Spring 2027 youth form, available since Nov 1, 2026. No closing date is posted, and positions are limited.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Spring 2027 youth form online. You name a teacher or counselor. The Science Center then emails them for a letter. Questions: call the Volunteer Office.
notes: Spots are limited. The volunteer page says 14 weeks and the form says 13 weeks, so ask if it matters to you. You need at least 50 hours before the Science Center will certify service hours. The same page lists other volunteer roles open at 16 (greeter, floor programs, gift store, office help) that ask for 4 hours a week for 6 months on the adult application. Volunteer Office: 213-744-2124 or VolunteerDept@californiasciencecenter.org.
